channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Mandelson’s ‘shocking betrayal’ needs criminal investigation says Labour MP
item.description: We speak to Labour MP Emily Thornberry, Chair of the Foreign Affairs Select Committee, to discuss the allegations against Lord Mandelson following the latest release of the Epstein files.

item.title: How did UK Met police react to alleged Royal links with Epstein?
item.description: It’s been three days since the US Department of Justice released the remaining Epstein files, and new details about his ties to the former Prince Andrew and his ex-wife Sarah Ferguson continue to emerge.

item.title: Epstein files: ‘I don’t think we’re going to get any real answers’ – investigative journalist
item.description: We were joined by investigative journalist Vicky Ward, who has spent decades reporting on Jeffrey Epstein in the US.

item.title: Russian captain guilty of fatal North Sea cargo ship crash
item.description: The Russian captain whose container ship crashed into a US oil tanker off the Yorkshire coast last year has been found guilty of causing the death of one of his crew.

item.title: Gaza: Rafah crossing reopens with limited travel and heavy Israeli security
item.description: Israel has reopened the Rafah crossing between Gaza and Egypt.

item.title: How Trump sent gold values crashing after record highs
item.description: Gold and silver prices fell again today after Friday's dramatic sell-off, triggered by President Trump's nomination of Kevin Warsh as the next US Federal Reserve chair.

item.title: Suffolk strangler: serial killer admits murder 26-years later
item.description: He's already in prison serving a whole life term for killing five women in 2006.

item.title: Doctors in England vote for six more months of strike action
item.description: Resident doctors in England have voted to continue industrial action for another six months, in their dispute over pay and jobs.

item.title: Shocking footage reveals illegal hound hunts in rural England
item.description: It's more than 20 years since hunting with hounds was banned in England.

item.title: John Bishop: comedian’s tale of divorce and standup hits Hollywood
item.description: When Hollywood A-lister Bradley Cooper wants to make a film based on your life, it's no joke.
